description: Selected original Sao Paulo 2026 qualifying lifecycle input, including its long Q1 interruption and the Q1 break at the old 19:45 UTC connection limit.
extraction: SessionInfo, SessionStatus and SessionData payloads are unchanged. Heartbeat retains every third original message, every heartbeat around the 19:45 boundary, and the last message. Its UTC uses payload.Utc because the stream prefix can freeze after session updates stop. TimingData retains selected original messages before/after the boundary and long interruption. Source line numbers refer to preserved txt files including the URL header.
